articles.title: Climate Talks End With No Deal
articles.summary: COP31 in Turkey ended with no deal after countries said no to a draft plan that left out fossil fuels. It is the first failed UN climate talks since 2009.

articles.title: Computer Problem Delays About 1,000 Delta Flights
articles.summary: A computer problem delayed about 1,000 Delta flights on Sunday, days before Thanksgiving.

articles.title: Will Thanksgiving Dinner Cost More This Year?
articles.summary: Grocery prices are up nearly 22 percent over five years, but two estimates disagree on whether this year's Thanksgiving meal will cost more than last year's.
